options.subtitle: Manage filtering, plugins, and authenticity assist.
options.loadingLargePages: This may take a moment on large pages

popup.setupPrompt: Finish setup to personalize what gets filtered.
popup.noMatchesYet: Nothing matched your block keywords yet. Add topics under Rules in the dashboard.
popup.diagnosticsUnavailable: Open a normal web page (not chrome:// or the extension UI) to view live scanner stats.

pageStatus.unsupported: Not available on this page type.
pageStatus.focusOff: Focus mode is off — filtering paused everywhere.
pageStatus.filtered: {{count}} items filtered — click any match to reveal.
pageStatus.noMatches: Scanned — nothing matched your rules yet.
pageStatus.newsNoMatchesHint: News sites often use factual headlines without promo or bait phrasing — noise rules may not match. For subject-based news filtering, enable Topic diet under Rules (full build, experimental).

language.heading: Interface language
language.description: Choose the language for SignalLens menus and setup. Additional translations will ship as locale templates are added.
language.saved: Preference saved — new strings apply immediately.

overview.tabIntro: Your control center — pick a browsing mode, see activity, and jump to detailed settings.
overview.activityEmpty: No pages scanned yet. Visit a site with posts or comments while focus mode is on.
overview.recentBlockedActive: {{count}} active on this page — click a row's block on the page or use the badge to reveal.
overview.recentBlockedEmpty: Nothing filtered this session yet. Promo-heavy or bait-style text is a good test while focus mode is on.
overview.controlStripDescription: Quick view of what's active. Click a chip to open the related settings.
overview.controlStripTopicNote: Optional topic diet (world/news subjects) lives under Rules → Topic diet and Plugins → Topic classifier — separate from noise filtering.
overview.insightsEmpty: Mark blocks as wrong or good from the popup or dashboard to see patterns here.
overview.setupCompleteBody: You can close this tab anytime. Reopen the dashboard from your browser's extensions menu → SignalLens → Options (or Manage extension).
overview.quickLinksEssentialHint: Most people stay on the wizard defaults. Open these only if you want to adjust sensitivity, keywords, or whitelisted work sites.
overview.quickLinksAdvancedHint: Plugins, authenticity assist, export/import, and developer tools.

quickLinks.plugins: Detectors, site hints, and authenticity assist

gettingStarted.heading: Getting started
gettingStarted.description: SignalLens runs on every normal web page. Visit a site with feeds or comments to see filtering in action.
gettingStarted.tipBrowse: Open a page with posts or comments — filtering starts automatically when focus mode is on.
gettingStarted.tipReveal: Filtered blocks show a small badge and are dimmed or blurred — click either to reveal. Nothing is permanently hidden.
gettingStarted.tipRules: Adjust topics and keywords under Rules, or switch browsing mode above.
gettingStarted.tipAuthenticity: Optional: enable authenticity assist under Plugins for advisory source checks (side panel).

advanced.heading: Advanced
advanced.restoreDefaultsConfirm: Reset filtering to Focus mode defaults from the install wizard? Site whitelist and custom keywords will be cleared. Allow-list domains are cleared too.
advanced.invalidImport: Could not read that settings file. Check the JSON format and try again.

privacy.tabIntro: Understand what leaves your device, export your setup, and access optional developer diagnostics.
privacy.heading: Privacy
privacy.description: Local-first by default. Remote API is optional and user-configured.

filtering.tabIntro: Control how aggressively content is classified and how matches appear on the page.
filtering.browsingModeNotice: {{mode}} browsing mode is active. Changes here switch you to a custom setup.
filtering.classifyDescription: How SignalLens decides what counts as noise — inference mode, match threshold, and active detectors.
filtering.scopeHonestyNote: SignalLens reads page text, not pictures or video. Image-only posts are not filtered.
filtering.nonSocialNote: On music players, review sites, and other non-feed pages, behavior and pattern detectors stay off and thresholds are more conservative. Whitelist music streaming in Rules to skip scanning entirely.
filtering.presentDescription: How filtered blocks look on the page. Click any match to reveal it.
filtering.sensitivityDescription: Higher sensitivity flags more content. Lower sensitivity reduces false positives.
filtering.detectorsDescription: Detectors run on extracted text from the universal scanner. Manage more under Plugins.
filtering.heuristicDescription: Keyword lists and patterns — works offline, no model download.
filtering.localPackDescription: Bundled ONNX model for semantic scoring. Requires local pack files.
filtering.languagePackDescription: Used when local pack inference is selected. Auto-matches page language when possible.
filtering.inferenceCore: Heuristic mode — works offline with no model files.
filtering.inferenceFull: Heuristic mode works offline with no model files. Local pack uses bundled ONNX weights.
filtering.escalationLabel: Escalate uncertain items to remote API (opt-in)
filtering.filterStyleDescription: Choose how filtered content appears on the page. Click any filtered block to reveal it.
filtering.appearanceDescription: Tune how blocked content looks on the page. Presets are a starting point — switch to Custom for full control.
filtering.appearanceContentOpacityHint: Lower = darker and harder to read.
filtering.appearanceCustomFootnote: Select Custom to adjust sliders. More community styles may ship as presets later.
filtering.advancedPackSummary: Advanced: language pack and ONNX routing
filtering.previewDescription: Paste text to see how your current sensitivity and enabled detectors would treat it — no page visit required.
filtering.previewPlaceholder: Paste a headline, comment, or promo line…
filtering.previewWouldPass: Would pass — below threshold or no matching signals
filtering.previewGated: Too short or low-signal — scanner would skip classification
filtering.previewBehaviorNote: Behavior signals use language-agnostic patterns (caps bursts, hooks, emoji/link spam) plus optional DOM sponsorship hints — not keyword lists alone.
filtering.feedbackMarkedWrong: Marked as wrong block — helps tune future filtering.
filtering.feedbackSummary: Your feedback: {{wrong}} wrong · {{ok}} good blocks recorded locally.
filtering.installDemoAlert: Pack installation would start here. Not implemented in this demo.
filtering.perSiteDescription: Set custom filtering thresholds for specific hostnames.

rules.tabIntro: Pause filtering on trusted sites, then choose topic presets and keywords.
rules.heading: Your Filtering Rules
rules.description: Topic presets add phrase groups in one click. Custom keywords fine-tune beyond presets.
rules.topicPresetsDescription: Toggle a topic to add or remove its phrase list. Off by default unless you enabled it in setup.

topicPresetHints.outrage: Drama, outrage, and boycott language in feeds.
topicPresetHints.spam: Promo codes, affiliate links, and sales CTAs.
topicPresetHints.hostile: Insults and hostile replies in comment threads.
topicPresetHints.engagement-bait: Hook headlines and “you won't believe” phrasing.
topicPresetHints.low-effort: One-liners like “lol” or “came here to say”.
topicPresetHints.geopolitics: Phrase list for news wording (e.g. “breaking news”, “airstrike”) — not full headline topics. BBC-style factual headlines often won’t match; use Topic diet for subjects.

topicDiet.heading: Topic diet (experimental)
topicDiet.description: Semantic subject filtering — separate from noise presets above. Requires the Topic classifier plugin (full build).
topicDiet.experimental: Research preview — local MiniLM embeddings, reveal-first dimming.
topicDiet.modRequired: Enable “Topic classifier (experimental)” under Plugins to activate.
topicDiet.enable: Enable topic diet on this profile
topicDiet.separateFromNoise: Topic blocks show subject labels (e.g. World affairs), not engagement/noise chips.

blockKeywords.title: Block keywords
blockKeywords.description: Content containing these phrases is more likely to be filtered.

allowKeywords.title: Allow keywords
allowKeywords.description: Content with these phrases is never filtered, even if it matches block rules.

allowDomains.title: Allowed domains
allowDomains.description: Filtering is paused on these sites (useful for work tools or email).

whitelist.heading: Site whitelist
whitelist.description: SignalLens will not scan or filter pages on these sites. Use this for work tools, spreadsheets, and apps where overlays would get in the way.
whitelist.presetsDescription: Turn on a group to skip scanning on common productivity and media apps.
whitelist.customDescription: Add any hostname (e.g. app.example.com). Matching subdomains are included automatically.

google-workspace.label: Google Workspace
google-workspace.hint: Docs, Sheets, Drive, Gmail, Calendar, and Meet

online-spreadsheets.label: Online spreadsheets
online-spreadsheets.hint: Microsoft Excel online, OneDrive, Airtable, and Coda

music-lyrics.label: Music streaming
music-lyrics.hint: Skips scanning on Spotify, Apple Music, YouTube Music, Tidal, and Deezer — recommended if synced lyrics look filtered

plugins.tabIntro: The universal scanner runs on every page. Enable optional site hints and detectors below.
plugins.heading: Plugin library
plugins.description: SignalLens discovers content with a universal scanner on every page. Site hints tune precision on specific hosts — no separate adapters required.
plugins.unlockCount: {{count}} mod(s) can be unlocked via signed packages.
plugins.advancedInstallDescription: For contributors and power users. Most people only need the bundled mods above.
plugins.advancedLockedDescription: These mods ship in the full build or via signed unlock packages. The core build works without them.

filterModels.heading: Filtering models
filterModels.description: Scanning finds text on the page; detectors classify it against your rules. Enable detectors below — heuristic keywords work offline without a cloud model.
filterModels.classifierDescription: Choose how matched content is scored before dimming or blur.
filterModels.heuristicHint: Keyword + pattern matching (default, no model download)
filterModels.localPackHint: On-device ONNX pack for stronger classification (full build)
filterModels.coreBuildOnnxNote: Local ONNX packs require the full build. Core build uses heuristic detectors — enable Noise patterns under Detectors below.

adaptationPacks.heading: Adaptation packs
adaptationPacks.description: Optional text-pattern supplements — phrase lists and behavior weights that merge with core detectors. No image analysis. Install only what you need.
adaptationPacks.privacyBanner: All scan and filter data stays on your device. Adaptation packs add local rules only: no network access, no upload, no storage of page content beyond the current session blocked-item preview.
adaptationPacks.noMatchingPacks: No packs match the current filters.
adaptationPacks.activeSummary: {{count}} pack(s) active for this page — {{keywords}} supplemental pattern(s) loaded.
adaptationPacks.noneActive: No adaptation packs enabled. Language-specific packs activate when the page language matches.
adaptationPacks.installHint: Community packs: run `pnpm adaptation:scaffold <slug>`, edit pack.json, then `pnpm adaptation:build <dir>`. Install the signed .signallens-mod.json via Plugin Library → Install package. See packages/adaptation-packs/README.md.

sectionDescriptions.hint: Optional. Improves region detection on Reddit and YouTube — filtering still works everywhere without these.
sectionDescriptions.detector: How text is classified. Heuristic keywords use your block lists; noise patterns add promo and bait phrasing.
sectionDescriptions.action: How matched blocks look on the page (dim, blur, or collapse). Also editable under Filtering.

plugins.notInProfile: Not in this build profile. Rebuild with `pnpm build:full` or install an unlock package (see `packages/mod-unlocks/`).

errors.notInCoreBuild: This plugin is not included in the core build. Run `pnpm build:full` or install a signed unlock package from packages/mod-unlocks/.

authenticity.heading: Authenticity assist (experimental)
authenticity.description: Selection-first research helper. Flags are advisory only — content is never hidden. Default: search-only (zero LLM tokens).
authenticity.allowFullPage: Allow full-page analysis in side panel (discouraged on social feeds)
authenticity.limitsHint: Max {{claims}} claims · {{results}} results per query. URLs must come from search results — the model cannot add links.

notes.selectionShort: Selection is very short — analysis may be limited.
notes.hasStatistics: Contains numbers or statistics — worth checking primary sources.
notes.factualWithoutLinks: Makes factual-sounding statements without links in the selection.
notes.noClaims: No checkworthy factual claims detected — report may be sparse.
notes.t1Ranking: T1 local ranking kept {{kept}} of {{total}} candidate claim(s).
notes.t1Fallback: No claim met the checkworthiness threshold — analyzing the strongest candidate only.

limitations.advisory: Advisory only — not a fact-check verdict.
limitations.noSources: No sources retrieved — do not infer truth from silence.
limitations.denseSite: Dense site — full-page scope may miss thread context.

assessments.sourcesFound: Sources found — open links below to verify this claim yourself.
assessments.noSources: No corroborating sources found in search results.
assessments.llmUnavailable: LLM comparison unavailable — review sources manually.

sidepanel.heading: Authenticity assist
sidepanel.disabledHint: Feature is off. Enable it in Options → Plugins → Authenticity assist.
sidepanel.reportTabNote: (Report opens in a dedicated tab on this browser.)
sidepanel.selectTextHint: Highlight text on the page, then run analysis.
sidepanel.denseSiteWarning: Dense site — full-page may miss thread context and use more quota.
sidepanel.noReport: No report yet. Choose a scope and run analysis.

errors.noActiveTab: No active tab. Open a normal web page and try again.
errors.httpOnly: Authenticity assist works on http(s) pages only.
errors.selectTextFirst: Select text on the page first (or switch to full-page scope).
errors.fullPageDisabled: Full-page analysis is disabled in settings.
errors.extractFailed: Could not extract page text. Try reloading the tab.

theme.heading: Appearance
theme.description: Choose light, dark, or match your system setting.

llm.localEndpointHint: Local servers (Ollama, LM Studio) usually need no API key. Use Refresh to load models.
llm.fetchingLocal: Fetching models from your local server…
llm.localFetchFailed: Could not reach local server — enter a model id manually or check the endpoint.
llm.configureUrl: Configure a chat completions URL to load models.
llm.modelsFoundCustom: {{count}} model(s) found — current selection is custom.

authenticity.badgeTitle: SignalLens authenticity assist (advisory only). Click to dismiss.

adapter-reddit.name: Reddit hints
adapter-reddit.description: Optional ignore/boost selectors for reddit.com precision tuning.
adapter-reddit.permissionsSummary: Adjusts universal scanner regions on Reddit.

adapter-youtube.name: YouTube hints
adapter-youtube.description: Optional ignore/boost selectors for youtube.com precision tuning.
adapter-youtube.permissionsSummary: Adjusts universal scanner regions on YouTube.

detector-heuristic-keywords.name: Heuristic keywords
detector-heuristic-keywords.description: Local keyword matching using your block and topic lists.
detector-heuristic-keywords.permissionsSummary: No network; runs on extracted text only.

detector-noise-patterns.name: Noise patterns
detector-noise-patterns.description: Detects promos, outrage bait, and engagement-bait phrasing (works with your keyword list).
detector-noise-patterns.permissionsSummary: No network; pattern matching on extracted text.

detector-behavior-signals.name: Behavior signals
detector-behavior-signals.description: Language-agnostic noise cues: shouting caps, emoji/link spam, engagement hooks, and sponsored DOM markers.
detector-behavior-signals.permissionsSummary: No network; reads extracted text and local DOM hints only.

detector-topic-classifier.name: Topic classifier (experimental)
detector-topic-classifier.description: Local semantic topic diet — block world/domestic news while allowing tech and culture.
detector-topic-classifier.permissionsSummary: Downloads MiniLM embeddings on first use; runs on extracted text only.

adaptation-universal-social.name: Universal social feed
adaptation-universal-social.description: Language-agnostic social-feed cues: stronger engagement-hook and emoji signals, plus common sponsored DOM markers.
adaptation-universal-social.permissionsSummary: Local text + DOM hints only. No network. No storage of page content.

adaptation-en-promo.name: English — promotional
adaptation-en-promo.description: Supplemental English promo phrases and ecommerce noise patterns.
adaptation-en-promo.permissionsSummary: Local pattern lists only. Active when page language is English.

adaptation-en-clickbait.name: English — clickbait
adaptation-en-clickbait.description: English engagement hooks and listicle-style bait phrasing for feeds and news.
adaptation-en-clickbait.permissionsSummary: Local pattern lists only. Active when page language is English.

adaptation-en-phishing.name: English — phishing
adaptation-en-phishing.description: English account-verification and urgency scam phrasing.
adaptation-en-phishing.permissionsSummary: Local pattern lists only. Active when page language is English.

adaptation-en-toxic.name: English — toxic
adaptation-en-toxic.description: English insult and outrage phrasing for feeds and comment threads.
adaptation-en-toxic.permissionsSummary: Local pattern lists only. Active when page language is English.

adaptation-de-promo.name: German — promotional
adaptation-de-promo.description: German promo and discount phrasing for shops and feeds.
adaptation-de-promo.permissionsSummary: Local pattern lists only. Active when page language is German.

adaptation-de-clickbait.name: German — clickbait
adaptation-de-clickbait.description: German engagement-bait and sensational headline phrasing.
adaptation-de-clickbait.permissionsSummary: Local pattern lists only. Active when page language is German.

adaptation-de-phishing.name: German — phishing
adaptation-de-phishing.description: German account-verification and urgency scam phrasing.
adaptation-de-phishing.permissionsSummary: Local pattern lists only. Active when page language is German.

adaptation-de-toxic.name: German — toxic
adaptation-de-toxic.description: German insult and outrage phrasing for feeds and comment threads.
adaptation-de-toxic.permissionsSummary: Local pattern lists only. Active when page language is German.

detector-remote-api.name: Remote API
detector-remote-api.description: Optional cloud classifier when you configure an endpoint.
detector-remote-api.permissionsSummary: Sends extracted text to your configured API URL.

detector-local-pack.name: Local ONNX pack
detector-local-pack.description: On-device model pack for stronger classification.
detector-local-pack.permissionsSummary: Loads bundled ONNX weights from extension storage.

detector-onnx-pack.name: ONNX pack (legacy alias)
detector-onnx-pack.description: Legacy detector id kept for compatibility with older settings.
detector-onnx-pack.permissionsSummary: Same ONNX session as local pack.

action-dim.name: Dim
action-dim.description: Softens matched content with lower opacity and grayscale.
action-dim.permissionsSummary: Updates inline styles on matched elements.

action-blur.name: Blur
action-blur.description: Blurs matched content until you choose to reveal it.
action-blur.permissionsSummary: Updates inline styles on matched elements.

action-collapse.name: Collapse
action-collapse.description: Collapses matched blocks behind a compact summary row.
action-collapse.permissionsSummary: Updates inline styles on matched elements.

browsingModes.heading: Browsing mode
browsingModes.description: One tap updates sensitivity, keywords, filter style, and site hint packs.
browsingModes.customNote: Custom — sensitivity and rules were edited manually.

focus.label: Focus
focus.description: Balanced filtering for everyday browsing — outrage, spam, and bait.

research.label: Research
research.description: Conservative threshold with light keyword rules — fewer false positives.

unwind.label: Unwind
unwind.description: Strict filtering across common noise categories.

shell.title: Welcome to SignalLens
shell.subtitle: Pick a browsing mode and start filtering in under a minute.

welcome.heading: Your personal browsing layer
welcome.body1: SignalLens helps you reduce low-value content while you browse. You stay in control — filtered items can always be revealed.
welcome.body2: Default mode is local and offline-friendly. No account required.
welcome.quickStartHint: Quick start applies the Focus browsing mode. You can change mode or rules anytime in the dashboard.
welcome.textOnlyLimitation: SignalLens reads page text, not pictures or video. Image-only posts are not filtered.
welcome.setupAgainNote: Your previous choices are pre-selected. Adjust anything, then finish to apply.

mode.heading: Choose a browsing mode
mode.description: Modes bundle sensitivity, topics, filter style, and site hints. Pick one to start, or customize your own rules.
mode.customHint: Pick topics, filter style, and sensitivity step by step.
mode.pickOne: Select a browsing mode or choose custom setup to continue.

done.heading: You're ready to browse
done.summaryPreset: {{mode}} mode is active. Visit any page with posts or comments to see filtering.
done.summaryCustom: Your custom rules are active. Visit any page with posts or comments to see filtering.
done.tipDashboardHandoff: Finish to open your dashboard. You can close that tab anytime and reopen it from Extensions → SignalLens.
done.tipBrowse: Open a normal website (not chrome:// pages) with a feed or comments.
done.tipReveal: Click filtered content to reveal it — nothing stays hidden permanently.
done.tipFineTuneLater: Optional: open the dashboard later to fine-tune filtering, plugins, or privacy.
done.tipDashboard: Use the dashboard to refine rules, plugins, and privacy settings.
done.tipModes: Switch browsing mode anytime from Overview or the toolbar popup.

language.heading: Interface language
language.description: Choose the language for SignalLens menus and setup. Additional translations will ship as locale templates are added.

topics.heading: What bothers you?
topics.description: We'll use these topics as keyword signals in heuristic mode.
topics.noiseVsTopicNote: These presets filter tone and phrasing (noise). An optional topic diet for news subjects is available later under Rules — separate from this step.
topics.pickAtLeastOne: Select at least one topic to continue.

botherCategories.geopolitics: News and geopolitics (optional — off by default in Focus)

style.heading: Filter style
style.description: Choose how matched content appears. You can change this later in settings.
style.coreBuildNote: This build includes dim only. Blur and collapse are available in the full build.

sites.heading: Sites you browse
sites.description: Select where you want optimized extraction behavior.

sensitivity.heading: Sensitivity
sensitivity.description: How aggressively should SignalLens flag content that matches your rules?

whitelist.heading: Skip filtering on work apps?
whitelist.description: Optional. SignalLens won't scan or filter pages on these sites — useful for email, documents, and spreadsheets.
whitelist.skipHint: You can skip this step or change whitelist sites anytime under Rules in the dashboard.

authenticity.heading: Research selected text (optional)
authenticity.description: Authenticity assist checks claims against public sources. It is advisory only — nothing is hidden automatically.
authenticity.experimentalNote: Experimental feature. Uses Wikipedia by default (no API key). Public sources only.
authenticity.enableHint: Search-only mode by default — zero LLM tokens until you add an API key later.
authenticity.llmApiKeyHint: Only needed for LLM synthesis (T3). You can add this later in Plugins.
authenticity.skipHint: Leave unchecked to skip — enable anytime from Plugins in the dashboard.
